title: Kulen Waterfalls
info: The waterfall area is one destination on the much larger Kulen plateau. Open the separate waterfall study to inspect the falls and walk its illustrative bank-side route.

title: Preah Ang Thom
info: A living place of worship associated with the reclining Buddha carved into a large sandstone boulder. The small pavilion here is a location symbol, not a reconstruction of the shrine or Buddha. A detailed study will follow separately.

title: River of a Thousand Lingas
info: Anlong Pong Phkay contains sacred riverbed carvings. It is a separate location from the waterfall and is not Kbal Spean. The river symbol identifies the area; it does not reproduce individual carvings.

title: Prasat Rong Chen
info: A terraced temple site connected with ancient Mahendraparvata on the plateau. Low terraces mark its location in this overview, not a restored temple. The surrounding forest is illustrative.

title: Srah Damrei
info: A forest site known for animal figures carved from sandstone. The boulder grouping is a location symbol only; the elephant and other sculptures have not yet been modeled.
